name: Mythic+ Life Stealing heals for what it drains, not for a share of the caster's own health (#8081)
contract: Affix Life Stealing (80026) procs Life Steal 80027 on melee hits: 'Drains 2% health from an enemy, transferring
it to the caster.' Effect 0 (Ascension effect 174) drains a share of the target's maximum health. Effect 1
healed the caster for 5% of its own maximum health, so creatures with key-scaled health healed several times what
they drained. The caster now heals exactly the drained damage. A low-health warrior carries the affix here so

steps.label: SETUP: Life Steal drains on hits
DISCRIMINATING: the caster heals for what it drained
